title: Charles H NDE 3445/4085 NDE 4084
content:
4084 It was July 20th 1987, first day on the job, it went good all day as we did concert stages, set up, tear down, load up, and move on. It was a hot day. A stage set up for the concert, it went well with Jenny Fricke and Emmie Lou Harris singing for the fraternal order of police fundraiser. The day was over at 8:00 pm. My helper and I tore down the stage and loaded it on the truck. We finished around 11:30 pm that night. The truck was loaded, I was the passenger, and all the lights were out on the field. We had to back up and use the truck lights to scan the area to make sure we got everything. As we were backing up the truck, it stalled. The driver said, 'Man! Chuck crawled under the truck and hit the starter with a hammer.' The truck was a cab over, so you could not raise the hood and be in it at the same time. I did what the driver suggested. I was laying right behind the passenger front tire. As I struck the starter, the first two times nothing happened. Then on the third hit, the truck starter turned over the truck jumped backwards up onto my left side pinning me to the ground. All of a sudden, I was short on breath, bleeding from my eyes and mouth. I was gagging on blood. The driver comes back and sees that I am hurt. He runs. I heard a loud banging noise. I looked over my head and saw someone maybe thirty to fifty yards away beating a trashcan against a dumpster. I don't know how I got it out, but I yelled, 'Help me please!' A man ran over (I later found out to be a cop). He called to the station for an ambulance. I was behind a police station in a ball field. The officer was in tears saying, 'Hold on fella. Help is coming.' I was in and out of consciousness. As I heard the sirens, I was gone. I felt my last gasp, and then all the pain was gone. As I was looking down, I heard the man say to the paramedics, 'He's gone.' They went to work on me, chest compressions, breathing into my mouth, no pulse. I was there above them watching. I heard a voice in the light. It said to me, 'It's time.' I said, 'No! Please my babies. I need to raise my babies!' All I could think of was my three babies ages four, three, and two years old at home. The light said, 'If you go back, you won't like it.' I said, 'I have to. Please. My babies need me!' I was watching my body there. All this was happening so fast. I heard the guy say, 'Up a hundred.' The other turned the knob on the machine. I said, 'Please, my babies!' The light replied, 'So be it!' Boom! That fast, I was screaming in pain back in my body there on the ground. They were telling me, 'Okay, okay, listen. We got a life flight coming. We have to take you out of the field. It can't land here, okay?' They loaded me onto a board and into the ambulance and took me out of the field. Once on the helicopter, they gave me something to ease the pain. It took eleven minutes to fly to Alleghany hospital in Pittsburg. They told me that I would never have made the twenty-five minutes by ambulance. Once we were there, they took me straight into surgery. I awoke nine days later to find out my intestines were torn into, my left lung was collapsed, my stomach lining was torn in many places and I had lost my left kidney. That's been twenty-two years ago, and let me say the light was right. I don't like it. I got divorced in 2003 when I caught my ex cheating. I have lower back pain all the time. I have had two heart attacks in three years and five stents put in my heart. I also had an angioplasty last month. So when the light speaks, I know from now on to listen because in my heart what I saw then and what I have been through no one but my God was there in that light - I saw others motion for me to come into the light. I have seen before here that had passed family as well as friends.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) 'ran over by 5 ton truck, total death occurred.' I was ran over by a five ton truck and crushed under the front tire. | Yes AccidentSurgery-related 'FIRST DAY ON JOB,TRUCK STALLED OUT,FELLOW WORKER TRYED TO START TRUCK WHILE I WAS LYING BEHIND FRONT TIRE,TRUCK JUMPED BACKWARDS UP ON TOP MY STOMACH...' Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) RAN OVER BY 5 TON TRUCK.... Well, I was bleeding from all parts of the body - eyes, nose, mouth, ears, I lost my left kidney as a result, I had my left lung collapsed, lines from my intestines severed, stomach lining torn.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Life review | Vision of the future | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above. | More consciousness and alertness than normal Pretty much all the time.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When watching the thing going on at the light, and looking down at my body. | Pretty much all the time.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning As if time was fast, so this all could take place. | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning It was all like a dream.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Everything was more clear, crisp, more real than real I guess is a way to state it. | All of this, this is what I mean by crisp.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Clearer. | It was different; I want to phrase it as knowing what you were hearing was certain even if you did not see movement producing it.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Leading to the light tubular area. | Yes It was a total tube of light, I saw no floor or walls or ceiling, only light totally around me and I was moving through it as though it was a tube or tunnel.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes The figure in the light that I say was God. | Yes I saw a form, that appeared to be of a male figure.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The voice came from the light it had a form as though it were what we see as God's form.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm the light,i was at all there | A clearly mystical or unearthly realm WHERE I WAS FIT THIS,THIS WAS A DIMENSION OF BEAUTIFUL LIGHT...
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: As I looked at what was to be my old body, it was as if it lived no more - but it was me. | Totally relaxed, unafraid, so, so comfortable.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control That if I returned I would not like it. | My past flashed before me, out of my control My life was around me it was in the light, like smoke, I could see it but was not drawn to it as I was the figure.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future They're still happening a hundred percent so far accurate, some I don't want to happen, but don't know how to stop them. | Scenes from the world's future I was told I would not like what was about to happen.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes More crisp in my belief. | Yes Much stronger.
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist | Moderate I HAVE A GREATER BELIEF NOW THEN EVER BEFORE.....
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes More crisp in my belief. | Yes Much stronger.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes Knowledge of things going on now in the news and other events yet to come. | No
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes Divorced and I keep people more distant. I used to hang to for fear of them being hurt. | Yes Divorce.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Divorced and I keep people more distant. I used to hang to for fear of them being hurt. After the NDE | tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Divorce. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain It was hard to tell anyone for years later for fear they would laugh. | Yes Still to this day it is, because when you start to touch upon the subject others stop paying attention, as if they are afraid to go there.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes The war issues, north Korea issues. | Yes Ability to help others, as if giving a gift.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Like I stated all this has been so different and sometimes I feel I am suffering for not going, sometimes this can be scary. | All of it.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Still feel it today as if it was yesterday, or yet, today. | Experience was probably real
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real As before, it's happening daily in front of me, on TV in the newspapers. | Experience was definitely real All of it was and it is my life now.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Just scary sometime, don't know if I want to lose the insight of what I have now though.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Please find out all you can about this, I know there are others who have been given gifts they are afraid to use, as I was.
